description: PROP-AUTH-022 claims to test 'session 401 when link session TTL expired' (REQ-AUTH-013) but actually calls consumeOAuthState (OAuth state consumption), not validateLinkSessionRecord or any link session operation. The test verifies OAuth state TTL expiry, duplicating PROP-AUTH-021, and leaves REQ-AUTH-013 integration behavior entirely untested at Tier 2.
